translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Yesuŋo Mikepka Dokoine Edoraki Sarikoi
Kaiwe maneo Yesu eŋe Genesaret namuŋ sawekino geki, so ŋei ŋerep loutneŋo Anutu wane don desikei wane Yesu wano lotke more, osino lewage more lolikkakoi.
Yesu eŋe otki, seki etke waraŋotpi sa qalakko metkoik, zawon teba teba ŋei eŋe sekiene qeliŋore ket so kamagaene sauke okorakoi,

pakiso, Yesuŋo sekiwa mane Saimon wane rara, ea wane kutno waki, pakiso Saimon rakaki, seki qebinkaki, qalakko ŋine qei qei weteke, pakiso, Yesu eŋe seki kutno mere, ŋei ŋerep magu suaine don kito edange.
Edangi qoekiso, Saimon olale rake, “Geŋone so kimatkeŋone ŋine sekiŋine esorogeu, qei namugo weteuk ma kamagaŋine zawon ebukei wane birau ketkep.”
Rakiso, Saimonŋo olatke, “Kito ebo ebon, ŋene goiŋ kirop pae urata suaine mene, ŋo zawon mane mi ebune, ŋo siluŋ goŋo ramainane, koso kamaga birawe ketkep.”
Yale ra more, eŋe kamaga birau ketki, zawon magu suaine kamagao watkeu, kamaga toeakane okange.

Pakiso, eŋe kimakopene seki maneo gekoi, yewa meteeneŋo pakonbi sarikoi, sariu so zawon peikeu, sekiwo wamage, seki etke eretnarek watkekoik. Pakiso, zawon umatneŋo etotki, seki etke yewa oroge kiwetko ketkeik wane okangoik.
Saimon Petoroŋo masi yewa kaki paki, Yesu wane kaitko wawetine qe more rake, “Waom! Qeliŋnane arinom, na ŋei borikine!”
Pakiso, Saimon eŋine so kimakoune weneŋ gekoi, eŋe zawon magu suaine ebukoi, yewa ka more welelepkekoi.

Saimon kimatkine, Yakop so Yohane, Zebedi wane gipoletkine, ere yale waka oŋaetne qaeke, pakiso, Yesuŋo Saimon olatke, “Mi kaet gangep, ge ukude zawon urata mamaine, boaŋ ŋei ŋerep yale waka eŋano urata ma more ebunom, naŋano sarikei.”
Pakiso, eŋe seki waraŋotpi qalakko wauk so, kine kineene korop qeliŋware so, Yesu ŋadino arikoi.
Yesuŋo Ŋei Mane Kubet Togole Saukkake
Atak maneo Yesu eŋe ari ŋei mane kubetŋo solaine korop rokopkaki geke, mat yewao lotkeke, pakiso ŋei yewa eŋe Yesu kaki paki, oŋomka tamge more rake, “Suaine, ge detnom paki, maine sauk nangene!”
Yesuŋo metine solaino ma more rake, “Na det ganmaile, wakoenom!” Rakiso, yewaoka kubetŋo osiki paki, ŋei qeliŋkaki menaŋge.

Pakiso, Yesuŋo ŋei wa rawetka more rake, “Ge kubetŋone osimaike, ea wane don kisiŋone ŋei mane mi edanikene, ge mosop ŋei, pris wano ari solaŋone sikankanom, kayake. Pakiso, solaŋone menaŋmaike, ea wane Mose wane don teweke more, soe soep mitnom, ŋei ŋerep eŋe ka more, solaŋone mo wakoemaike, yale desikei.”
Ŋo siluŋ Yesuŋo ŋeiwa kubetine maki osike, ea wane don kisiŋo sua arike, pakiso, ŋei ŋerep loutneŋo Yesu wane donine desikei wane, so zoma kubet korop yewa sauk oniakane sarikoi.
Yesu eŋe Anutuŋo zonom maniakane, kepe ŋei me mat kine kine midaine, yaup sai pamaike, yewao eŋineka ari more, meŋe meŋen urata mamageke.
Yesuŋo Ŋei Mane Kie Metine Seu Seune Ma Menaŋkake

Kaiwe maneo, Yesuŋo ŋei ŋerep don kito edange, Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei, Parisi so Skribe, eŋe weneŋ yewa metkoi, eŋe Galili kepeo mat mere arike, yewa ŋine so Yuda ŋine so Yerusalem ŋine. Waom wane zonomŋo weneŋ Yesurop geki, zomaenerop ma menaŋ onge.
Pakiso, ŋei natne eŋe ŋei mane kine so metine seu seune, yewa supiwo ma birau ketkiso teweke, Yesuŋo ma menaŋ kayakane eŋano ma arikoi.

Ari more, mat koto ma wakesikei wane, ŋei ŋerep magu suaine eŋano qekakoi, pakiso, teweke weti mat bakine kutno ma wa more, mat bakine lalageso, sopiinerop birakau mat koto, ŋei ŋerep magu eŋane keuno Yesu wane kaitko ket pake.
Pakiso, Yesuŋo mali malipene korop pa ebonge, yewa kaki pakiso, ŋei wa kie metine seu seune olale rake, “Kimane, geŋane sotŋone mo matali ginmaile.”

Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei, Skribe so Parisi, eŋe don yewa dere more, edomka auye rakoi, “Ŋei iwa eŋe ma ŋeiŋo Anutu ma baik kamaike me? Ŋei maneŋo maine borikine mi mataliake, Anutu wekuŋo maine borikine mataliake!”
Yale auwi, Yesuŋo wetenane kine dere more, edane rake, “Ŋine wetŋineŋo onoka wane yaline wetkemami?
Diawaŋo ewekine raikene, ‘Geŋane borikineŋone mo matali ginmaile,’ me raikene, ‘Wienom paki, arinom?’

Na ra qelaŋan ŋunbe, Ŋei Wawainane Gipole, eŋe kepeo borikine matali matali wane zonom pa manmaike.” Yesuŋo yale edangi pakiso, ŋeiwa kie metine seu seune olatke, “Na golatpe, ge wienom! Papaŋone manom paki, matko arinom!”
Rakiso, ŋeiwa eŋe ikopka ŋei ŋerep eŋane deene kutno wie more papaine more pake, yewa ma more, so matino ari Anutu bakomine kitoke.
Ŋei ŋerep eŋe yewa ka more, zok welelepkekoi! So kaetongi, Anutu bakomine kito more rakoi, “Masi kine mane, mi kakaze, iwa ukude wakongi kamaine!”
Yesuŋo Lewi Oraki Ŋadino Arike
Ea wane ŋadino, Yesuŋo ari more kaki, ŋei mane takis mama, eŋetine Lewi, eŋe takis mama urumino metke, pakiso Yesuŋo olale rake, “Ŋadeno modatnane sarinom.”
Rakiso, Lewi eŋe wie more, kine kineine korop ŋadekkawareso, Yesu ŋadino arike.
Pakiso, Lewiŋo Yesu wane ŋara soep suaine matino mitwarekiso, takis mama ŋei, so ŋei yauwine natne loutneŋo weneŋ ererop zakeo mere nekoi.
Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei, Parisi so Skribe eŋane tego natne eŋe Yesu wane dokoine eŋane detpi boriki rakoi, “Ŋine onoka wane takis mama so borikine mama eŋerop ŋara doku nemami?”
Rauso, Yesuŋo mange edange, “Ŋei ŋerep solaene maine eŋe dokta wano mi ari okanmami, zoma kubetenerop edoka weku ari okanmami.
Na ŋei ŋerep maine eŋet biŋek korop eŋe edorawe wetene maingekei wane mi ketkole, na borikine mama edorawe, wetene maingekei wane ketkole.”
Sawe Gege Wane Qeso Qeson

Ŋei ŋerep natne eŋe Yesu olale rakoi, “Yohane wane dokoine eŋe ŋara doku wane sawe ge more, naso baŋem meŋenka okanmami. So Anutu papa togon welaine ŋei Parisi, eŋane dokoene eŋe yale waka okan okanmami, ŋo geŋane dokone yemo ŋara doku nemami.”
Yesuŋo edane rake, “Ŋei mane ŋanomine mayake, eŋane lobokoune eŋane ŋara mawaulukeu, ŋerep ŋaone eŋe weneŋ eŋerop metkika ŋido maine ŋara mawalukeu, eŋe ŋara midaine arikei me? O weneŋ midaka!
Eŋe boaŋ ŋadino ŋerep ŋaone ea ma ariu, kimakoune eŋerop weneŋ mi metki, ra togole onbi, kimakoune ea eŋe maine ŋara midaine arikei.”

Yesuŋo don saeŋine iwa yale waka edange, “Man maŋo tutu mane takot muselo ŋine matoke more, takot sogine bara warakine yewao more qetusiake. Eŋe yalewa okangi, takot musele yewa barakeake, pakimo takot muselane tutuine yewaŋo takot sogine yewao mo rokopkeake.
Me mane maŋo wain musele qeki nomare sogine yewao weteake, eŋe yalewa okangi, wain musele yewaŋo nomare sogine yewa abongi poripkeki, wain ea qakeake, pakimo, nomare ea muzugeake.
Mida! Wain musele ea qeu nomare muselo weteake!
Mane eŋe wain sogine neki similekake, eŋe wain muselane bauine wamaike, paki ramaike, ‘Wain sogine yemo weku mane.’”
